neighbours.label: a head noun whose frame demands a restrictive modifier next ('in a manner [that]', 'the only place [where]', 'is one [drawn by]')
fire: The waste must be stored in a manner that prevents leaks.
Texas is not the only state where this law applies.
A good leader is one who listens before speaking.
She finished in three days the work that had taken him a month.
This is the kind of film that stays with you for weeks.
Paris was the first city to ban the cars from its centre.
The reason he left was never explained to the staff.
It was the only time that the team lost at home all season.
quiet: The waste is collected every Tuesday by the city.
Texas has more cattle than any other state.
Our leader spoke for an hour at the meeting.
She finished the work early and went home.
We watched a long film at the cinema last night.
Paris is a large city on the river Seine.
He left the office early because he felt sick.
The team lost at home on Saturday afternoon.
